guardrails: No revised-history fallback for PIT validation
No additional provider pipelines after stopping-rule trigger

price_oos_withheld_reason.reason: Frozen historical runtime does not expose reusable EURUSD, USDCAD, EURCAD, or ECB price-matrix series. Reconstructing them would require a new price-data pipeline, which is excluded by the stopping rule.

what_is_validated: The v9.3 macro block math has been replayed on PIT/first-release data for available currencies without revised-history fallback.
EUR and CAD have usable PIT Growth+Labour macro replay.
USD has usable PIT Growth replay but no complete macro vote because Labour is unavailable.
The dataset freeze gate prevents pending/withheld series from voting.
what_is_not_validated: A full 8-currency PIT backtest of the complete engine.
A full PIT Macro+Rates+CB/OIS+COT+Liquidity replay across all 28 pairs.
Price-forward hit rates from the newly frozen PIT macro sample, because the canonical historical FX price matrix is not present in the frozen runtime artifacts.

legacy_benchmark.use: Benchmark only; macro layer there uses current-revised history and must not be presented as PIT backtest evidence.

next_step: Use this audit as the validation boundary. Do not tune thresholds from the partial PIT sample. Continue model development only with explicit labels separating PIT-validated macro components from pseudo-OOS benchmark evidence.
